title: FR: Watch alert for leaving phone Bluetooth range
symptom: The user requests an option for a missed readings alert on the watch that triggers even when the phone is off or out of Bluetooth range, to alert the user when they have left their phone's range or the phone battery dies.
evidence_quote: Could there be an option to have a missed readings alert that will go off on the watch even when the phone is turned off or not in communication with the watch?
